report.title: vim-opencode GUI smoothening plan (popups + styling from fzf.vim)

repository.name: vim-opencode
repository.description: A Vim 9.1-native client for OpenCode (OpenCode V2 HTTP/SSE APIs).

reference.description: fzf.vim structure and popup/styling implementation analysis used as the design source.

report.audience: An engineer implementing styled popups, an interactive command palette, preview windows, and a show/peek key in vim-opencode, modeled on fzf.vim.
report.summary: vim-opencode currently lists pickers with plain :echomsg / inputlist() / popup_menu() and has no single entry point reaching every :Opencode command. This plan adopts fzf.vim patterns from fzf_analysis.json (spec dict, highlight-group-derived colors via s:get_color/s:ansi/s:key_label, borders --list-border/--header-border/--info inline-right/--no-separator, preview window --preview/--preview-window, show/peek key ctrl-o via IPC fifo + win_execute, footer hints s:build_hint, layout keys window/up/down/left/right/popup/tmux) to converge on one or a few interactive window(s) that reach all commands. Work is split into six phases: foundation/style runner, styled pickers, command palette, preview windows, show/peek key, panel chrome + docs/tests.
report.goal: Smooth the GUI experience and provide an interactive window (or multiple) that can reach every :Opencode command, using fzf.vim popups and styling.

current_ui.panel: Split transcript (output) + input windows, text-property highlights, buffer-local mappings (q, ]m, [m, ]u, [u, <CR>, C-p, C-n).
current_ui.pickers: catalog.vim ShowPicker uses popup_menu() with inputlist() fallback; sessions.List/Pick and permissions.Pending print :echomsg lines.
current_ui.dispatch: Single :Opencode command with -complete=customlist,g:VimOpencodeComplete; COMMANDS table maps names to handlers (P0-P10 phases).
current_ui.limitations: No borders/titles/footers on popups, no preview pane, no peek key, no unified command launcher, colors not derived from highlight groups.

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: autoload/fzf/vim.vim: source/options/sink/sink*/window/exit/_paste/_show/_hint merged into one s:fzf runner.
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: One vim_opencode#ui#popup#run(spec) runner for pickers, palette, preview; each surface builds a spec dict.

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: s:get_color(attr, group...), s:csi(color, fg), s:ansi(str, group, default, bold), s:black/red/green/yellow/blue/magenta/cyan wrappers.
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: autoload/vim_opencode/ui/style.vim: derive popup border/title/entry colors from VimOpencode* groups via synIDattr(synIDtrans(hlID(group)), 'gui'|'cterm'), with termguicolors/cterm/16-color fallbacks; style#key_label for C-X/A-S.
popup_create border chars, title bar, inline info line, separator control; consistent across panel, palette, pickers.

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: --preview + --preview-window (e.g. '+{2}/2' center on field); Colors spec.window tight popup; commit/git diff previews.
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: ui/preview.vim side preview: session messages/diff, model provider/model, command description/hint, permission request, diff text.

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: ctrl-o via s:can_show + s:add_hints + autoload/fzf/vim/ipc.vim fifo + win_execute; opens entry in origin window without closing fzf.
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: C-O binding on every popup; run highlighted entry handler in origin window via win_execute without closing the popup; same preconditions (terminal +patch-8.0.995, win_execute, not Win32).

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: s:build_hint (Enter Open, C-X HSplit, C-V VSplit, C-T Tab; magenta keys via Special), s:key_label (C-X, A-S, S-, Dbl-).
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: Every popup footer: Enter pick, C-P preview, C-Q quit, C-H help; consistent modifier labels.

fzf_patterns_to_adopt.fzf_reference: window/up/down/left/right (+ popup/tmux), g:fzf_layout fallback; s:can_show rejects enew/tabnew/tabedit/<tab> for show key.
fzf_patterns_to_adopt.vim_opencode_use: popup layout width/height/row/col; fallback to split/inputlist when +popupwin unavailable.

phases.name: Foundation & spec runner
steps: Add gui.* defaults + validation (popup_border, popup_title, footer_hint, preview_width, colors) to config.vim Defaults/Validate.
Create style.vim: style#get_color, style#ansi, color wrappers for VimOpencode* groups, style#key_label.
Create popup.vim vim_opencode#ui#popup#run(spec): bordered popup, title, footer, callback, preview, keymaps, inputlist() fallback.
phases.acceptance: :Opencode palette stub opens a bordered popup listing commands; no hard-coded colors; graceful fallback without +popupwin.

phases.name: Styled pickers (replace inputlist()/popup_menu())
steps: Convert catalog.vim model/agent/command pickers to styled popups with title + footer hint (Enter pick / C-P preview / C-Q quit).
Convert sessions.List/Pick and permissions.Pending to the same styled runner.
Add preview callbacks: session latest message, model provider/model, command description/hint.
phases.acceptance: model pick, agent pick, command pick, session pick, permission list open bordered titled popups with footer hints; inputlist() fallback retained.

phases.name: Interactive command palette (reach all commands)
steps: Register palette in COMMANDS and wire Dispatch() to palette.Palette().

Build palette.vim: flattened source of all COMMANDS + sub-actions (session/model/agent/command/permission/diff/review/tab), as-you-type fuzzy filter, Enter run, C-P preview, C-Q close, C-H help, jk/↑↓ navigate, MRU.
Add opt-in <Leader>oc mapping consistent with existing default_mappings/keymaps.
phases.acceptance: One palette popup launches every :Opencode command and sub-action without leaving normal mode.

phases.name: Preview windows (fzf --preview / --preview-window)
steps: Add preview support to popup runner: second popup/split showing context for highlighted entry.
Preview providers: session messages/diff, model key/provider/modelID, command description+hint, permission request, diff text (reuse diff.vim).
Center preview on matched field where applicable (analogous to '+{2}/2').
phases.acceptance: Moving the picker/palette cursor updates a side preview without closing the list.

phases.name: Show / peek key (fzf ctrl-o)
steps: Add C-O show_key to every popup; run highlighted entry handler in origin window via win_execute(origin_winid, ...) without closing popup.
Guard with s:can_show-style preconditions (terminal +patch-8.0.995, win_execute, not Win32, no bang/fullscreen).
phases.acceptance: C-O in a picker opens the selected session/model/command in the editing window while the popup stays open.

phases.name: Panel chrome & consistent styling
steps: Add title bar + border + footer hint line to split panel (InfoChunk header rendered as chrome).
Apply highlight-derived colors and key labels to panel mappings (q, ]m, [m, ]u, [u, <CR>, C-p, C-n).
Add fzf1/fzf2/fzf3-style statusline pill showing server/session/model while panel is open.
phases.acceptance: Panel and popups share border/title/footer styling; statusline pill reflects connection state.

phases.name: Polish, config, docs, tests
steps: Document gui.* options, palette, pickers, preview, peek keybindings in doc/vim-opencode.txt and FEATURES.md.
Add headless smoke tests: popup open/close, picker selection, palette dispatch, fallback without +popupwin, show/peek.
Run ./test/run.sh and fix regressions.
phases.acceptance: Full test suite passes; help file documents all new GUI options and keys.

risks.risk: +popupwin / popup_create() missing on older Vim 9.1 builds
risks.mitigation: Guard with has('popupwin')/exists('*popup_create()'); fall back to inputlist()/:echomsg.
Derive from highlight groups via style#get_color; gui.colors = 0 to disable.

risks.risk: Popup mappings interfere with buffer-local mappings
risks.mitigation: <buffer>-scoped mappings inside popup only; restore focus to origin window on close.
Keep peek sync; job_start/timer only for network/preview work; never sleep.

risks.risk: Long command lists slow the popup
risks.mitigation: Cap palette source; fuzzy filter incrementally; lazy-load server catalogs.

success_criteria: One interactive palette popup can reach every :Opencode command and sub-action.
All pickers (model, agent, command, session, permission) are styled bordered popups with footer hints.
Colors are derived from Vim highlight groups (no hard-coded ANSI), honoring termguicolors/cterm.
Preview pane shows context for the highlighted entry; show/peek key works without closing popups.
Graceful fallback to inputlist() when +popupwin is unavailable.
Plan + implementation committed on branch feature/gui-popup-styling-plan; tests pass.
